description: This file defines the WorkWeekController class within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It manages the rendering of the 'work-week' component by setting properties related to work day types, including full day, half day, and non-working day, utilizing internationalization helpers for label translations.

classes.name: WorkWeekController
classes.description: Controller managing the 'work-week' component rendering and data setup for the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares and sets up the 'work-week' component by defining work day types with localized labels.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns the data groups required for capability checking, specifically 'work_week'.
